<title level="1" right="Rules">[Long-Term Rest](/Rules.aspx?ID=2446)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 440

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
You can spend an entire day and night resting during downtime to recover Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1) multiplied by double your level.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
